name: CircleCI
label: CircleCI API v2
description: CircleCI API v2 via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://circleci.com/docs/api/v2/index.html. Operations: pipeline_get, pipeline_list, pipeline_trigger, pipeline_run, workflow_cancel, job_get, listen. pipeline_run is POST /project/{project-slug}/pipeline/run (current Cloud trigger; https://circleci.com/docs/guides/orchestrate/triggers-overview/). pipeline_trigger is the older POST /project/{project-slug}/pipeline (still documented for CircleCI Server). Auth secret token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen/trigger are kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Failures are output.error. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: pipeline_get | pipeline_list | pipeline_trigger | pipeline_run | workflow_cancel | job_get | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'pipeline_get'.

schema.label: definition_id
schema.description: Pipeline definition id for pipeline_run (Project Settings → Pipelines). Sent in the JSON body of POST /project/{project_slug}/pipeline/run. https://circleci.com/docs/api/v2/index.html#tag/Pipeline/operation/triggerPipelineRun

schema.label: parameters
schema.description: Request-body parameter `parameters` for operations: pipeline_trigger, pipeline_run.

schema.label: id
schema.description: URL path parameter `id` for operation: workflow_cancel. Required by: workflow_cancel.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: pipeline_get, pipeline_list, pipeline_trigger, pipeline_run, workflow_cancel, job_get, listen. pipeline_run is the current Cloud trigger; pipeline_trigger remains for CircleCI Server. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Token
configurationParameters.description: CircleCI personal API token. Header Circle-Token. Never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
